sentences.text:
By this application under section 482 Cr.P.C., the petitioner has assailed the order dated 22.10.2019 passed by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur in C.R.
Case No.199/2010, thereby framing charge under section 16 read with section 17 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, the petitioner has also prayed for quashing of the proceedings.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Page No.# 2/2

By referring to the documents annexed to this application and examination as well as the cross-examination of P.W.1 and P.W.2 recorded before framing of charge, it is submitted that there is no evidence before the learned trial Court that the petitioner was the nominated person under section 17(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 as regards FCI Godown at Japisajia, North Lakhimpur.
It is submitted that as per the documents and evidence on record, one another person was the nominated vendor.
Hence, it is submitted that the prosecution would not be maintainable.
Having heard the learned APP for the State, this Court is inclined to issue notice returnable in 4 (four) weeks.
No steps is required to be taken in respect of respondent No.1, who is represented by the learned APP.
However, notice on the respondent No.2 may be served by registered post with A/D.
Steps within 2 (two) days.

The respondent No.2 is further directed to produce any documents by virtue of which it can be prima facie shown that the petitioner, namely, Sri Lavajyoti Bora was the authorized and nominated vendor under section 17(2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 in respect of FCI Depot at Japisajia, North Lakhimpur.
A copy of the order may also be provided to the learned APP to enable him to communicate with the respondent No.2.

In addition, liberty is granted to the learned counsel for the petitioner to serve a copy of this order to the learned standing counsel for the Directorate of Health Service, Assam so as to enable the notice of the Court to be served on respondent No.2.
He is also permitted to serve copy of the order to the P.W.s sought to be examined by the prosecution on 02.03.2020.

In view of the pendency of the application, the petitioner is permitted to pray for an adjournment before the learned trial Court and on such prayer being made, the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur shall adjourn C.R. Case No. 119/2010 till 4 (four) weeks.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lakhimpur, North Lakhimpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: List after 4 (four) weeks.
The prayer for interim relief shall be considered on the next returnable date.
